dedupe_keys.name: csp guru database of concentrating solar power plants of the world

description: CSP.guru is an open database of the concentrating solar power stations of the world for energy modellers and analysts. It is maintained by Richard Thonig, Johan Lilliestam and co-authors at the Research Institute for Sustainability, Helmholtz Centre Potsdam, with later versions compiled with the SolarPACES secretariat and funded by SolarPACES and the openCSP project. It holds technical, economic, financial and industrial data on all operating stations and those under construction, plus several pilots, with fields added over time such as local spelling of names and hybridisation capacity with other power sources. Coverage is worldwide at plant level; the latest version reflects the market as of 1 July 2023. Data come as a Frictionless tabular data package (a CSV with a datapackage.json) plus an Excel file, on GitHub with versions archived on Zenodo, under CC-BY-4.0 at no cost. Caveats: data are compiled from public sources as described in the original paper, and the database has not been updated since mid-2023. Simulation uses are capacity and cost assumptions for concentrating solar power in energy system models. Related records: none linked on the provider's pages read on the day.
